## Overview
VersionTooltips is a simple mod adds the ability to display the version as well as the snapshot an item was first introduced in the game directly inside an in-game tooltip. It is highly customizable with many different features and options and very useful when playing or building  in servers that use [ViaVersion](https://modrinth.com/plugin/viaversion), [ViaFabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabric), [ViaFabricPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabricplus), [ViaBackwards](https://modrinth.com/plugin/viabackwards), etc. where having the version displayed directly inside the game saves a lot of time.
Supports every vanilla item and handles every special case such as potions, splahs potions, lingering potions, tipped arrows, enchanted books and paintings.

## Information

- [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) is only required when using [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/)
- Enchanted books' data is coherent with the version/snapshot the respective enchantment was added not the **enchanted book itself**.

## Features
- Universal Mod Toggle
- Show Only on Keybind Press
- Configurable Keybind in Minecraft Options
- Only Show With Advanced Tooltips (F3+H)
- Changeable Style (Vanilla/Modded)
- Changeable Types:
  - Version Only
  - Snapshot Only
  - Version (Snapshot)
  - Snapshot (Version)
- Search by version in Creative Menu
